title: Youngest of ten

captions.instagram:
I'm the youngest of ten children. Born and raised in Brooklyn, a first-generation American.

My parents gave us three values: togetherness, family and hard work. My father, Norman N. Jemal, was also my mentor. We worked together at our family discount store in Spanish Harlem.

Swipe for where those values show up in my story, and save the three-question check on the last slide.

#Brooklyn #FamilyBusiness #Entrepreneurship

Which value did your family pass down to you?

captions.linkedin:
The values a family runs on can become the values a business runs on.

I'm the youngest of ten children, born and raised in Brooklyn, a first-generation American. My parents gave us three values: togetherness, family and hard work.

My father, Norman N. Jemal, was my mentor. We worked together at our family discount store in Spanish Harlem. By 16, I had started four electronics and music specialty stores. In 1976, my father opened the first Wiz on Fulton Street in downtown Brooklyn.

Three questions I'd put to any founder:
1. Who are you building with?
2. Who are you building for?
3. What are you learning by doing?

#FamilyBusiness #Leadership

Which value from your upbringing shows up most in how you work?
